Signal Kit

You lift the whistle and angle the polished mirror toward the sun.

Rules

ID: item-signal-kit

Market price: 4 coins. Bulk: 1.

Whistle, small bell and ordinary signaling mirror. Works only where sound or reflected light can reach; no magical communication, special detection or bonus.

Buying equipment grants no DP advancement, training or ability. Use normal item-handling actions unless an applicable card says otherwise.
